    Plot Linkage Disequilibrium Heatmap Around a Focal Variant

    plot_single_snp_ld.Rd

    Isolates flanking markers inside a physical window, filters out variants with a low Minor Allele Frequency (MAF), and renders a correlation matrix heatmap.

    plot_single_snp_ld(
  geno,
  map,
  focal_snp,
  window_bp = 1e+05,
  marker_col = "SNP",
  chr_col = "Chromosome",
  pos_col = "Position",
  min_maf = 0.05
)

    Arguments

    geno

    A numeric matrix or data frame of genotype. Rows are samples, columns are SNPs. First col is taxa

    map

    A data frame containing variant metadata map records (SNP, Chromosome, Position).

    focal_snp

    Character string identifying the central target SNP (significant SNP).

    window_bp

    Numeric. Distance upstream/downstream to include variants. Default is 100000 (100kb).

    marker_col

    Character. Column name for variant IDs in the map file. Default is "SNP". Change the SNP name to your map col name

    chr_col

    Character. Column name for chromosomes in the map file. Default is "Chromosome".

    pos_col

    Character. Column name for base-pair positions in the map file. Default is "Position".

    min_maf

    Numeric. Minor Allele Frequency threshold to filter variants. Default is 0.05.

    Value

    A list containing the ggplot object, the raw $r^2$ correlation matrix, and filtered maps/genotypes. This plot shows the correlation of the significant or focal SNP to other SNPs. Focal SNP is indicated with a "*"
